description: Lists every fact sebbi.pro's compliance checks read, for all frameworks or the ones named: the field name, the rule it must meet, the plain-English fix, how many checks it affects, and a blank record to fill in. Use it before sebbi_run_everything. Fill fields only from real facts about the system; leave unknowns empty. Read-only.

frameworks.description: Framework keys (e.g. euaiact, gdpr, dora, iso42001) as a list or comma-separated; leave out for all.
